column1: # catalog/archie-stop-the-line.tsv — which open alerts are a stop-the-line
# event (BH-4588). Read by bin/lib/archie-fm-report/stl.sh afr_stl_class, once
# per open alert on every bin/archie-fm-report.sh tick. An event gets ONE
# immediate Telegram beat per incident (<alert-id>@<first_seen epoch>) once the
# alert has been open for the minutes in its settings row.
# Columns, tab-separated: class, alert-id glob, settings key of the minimum
# age in minutes. Rows are read top to bottom and the FIRST match wins. A row
# whose class is `-` is an exclusion: an id it matches is no event, whatever
# a later row says (another lane's alert that shares a prefix).
# Sources of the ids: main-red-<slug> bin/main-red-detector.sh (the same ids
# bin/lib/archie-fm-watch/sources.sh afw_match reads), main-red-bisect_* and
# main-red-prs:* are other lanes' alerts; mc-window-stall-<scope>
# bin/lib/fanin-window-stall.sh; pool-box-<box> bin/lib/pool-placement.sh; the
# cost ids pipeline-health and the budget stop (afw_match's cost-anomaly).
# ph-costrollupstale_hub is a stale rollup, not a spike: it matches no row.
main-red
queue-stalled
box-down
spend-spike
spend-spike
